共同操作

A1

操作记录：Table 1 three-stage optimization protocol；步骤 1：combine 1a, 2a and K2CO3 in acetone; heat；步骤 2：add tBuOK in THF at 0 °C；步骤 3：allow to warm from 0 °C to room temperature and stir；步骤 4：add catalyst, ligand, base, NH-sulfoximine and step-III solvent; stir

A2

通法出处：General procedure for 4a；操作记录：Three-stage one-pot scope procedure；步骤 1：heat in acetone；步骤 2：add tBuOK in THF at 0 °C；步骤 3：warm from 0 °C to room temperature；步骤 4：carbonylation/annulation stage；步骤 5：filter through silica pad and wash with ethyl acetate (inherited general procedure)；步骤 6：silica gel column chromatography, petroleum ether/ethyl acetate 10:1–3:1 (inherited general procedure)

A3

操作记录：CO-purged room-temperature annulation followed by silica workup/purification；步骤 1：purge with CO three times and stir；步骤 2：filter through a short silica pad and wash with ethyl acetate；步骤 3：silica gel column chromatography, petroleum ether/ethyl acetate 10:1–3:1 (v/v)

A4

操作记录：CO-purged room-temperature annulation；步骤 1：purge with CO three times and stir
